title: centaurea decipiens subsp. ruscinonensis
intro: Centaurea decipiens subsp. ruscinonensis, commonly known as the Ruskin knapweed, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea decipiens subsp. ruscinonensis include its potential to act as an antiseptic, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in wound healing and skin care. However, the bioactive constituents responsible for these effects are not well-documented, and further research is needed to fully understand the plant's properties and potential uses.
